name: Eleven v4 Turbo
access: ElevenLabs API: Text to Dialogue WebSocket

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text streamed in, with optional inline audio tags
voice.output_audio: MP3 (22.05 kHz at 32 kbps, 24 kHz at 48 kbps, 44.1 kHz at 32 to 192 kbps), PCM 8 to 48 kHz 16-bit, WAV 8 to 48 kHz, Opus 48 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), mu-law 8 kHz and A-law 8 kHz; the default is mp3_44100_128; MP3 at 192 kbps needs the Creator plan or above, and PCM or WAV at 44.1 kHz needs Pro or above [el-api-tts]; ElevenAgents defaults to PCM 16 kHz output and accepts PCM 8 to 48 kHz and mu-law 8 kHz [el-api-agents]
voice.voices: custom cloning: library voices (the maker's pages give 3,000+, 10,000+ and 5,000+ as counts), instant and professional voice clones, and designed voices [el-tts-overview] [el-voices]; the Text to Dialogue WebSocket allows exactly one registered voice for this model [el-ws-ttd]
languages: 90+ languages; the models page lists them by ISO 639-3 code [el-models]
voice.turn_detection: none in the model. The Text to Dialogue WebSocket takes new_turn or a change of voice_id as a turn boundary; in ElevenAgents the platform's turn-taking system decides when the agent speaks [el-ws-ttd] [el-agents-flow]
voice.interruption: Not handled by the model. In ElevenAgents, users can interrupt unless interruptions are disabled for the agent or a tool; on the Text to Dialogue WebSocket the docs describe no cancel message [el-agents-flow] [el-ws-ttd]
voice.latency: Median inference latency about 100 ms, excluding application and network latency [el-models]; the maker's launch material gives a median time to first speech of about 150 ms, measured in September 2026 with network latency removed [el-blog-v4], and a news site relays the maker's comparison chart: 262 ms for Cartesia Sonic 3.6 and 814 ms for GPT-4o mini TTS [pr-testingcatalog]
voice.session_limit: Text to Dialogue WebSocket: closes after 20 seconds without a client message unless keep_alive is sent; each open connection holds one dialogue session from a pool of 14 (Free) to 105 (Scale, Business) [el-ws-ttd] [el-models]. The models page lists no character limit for this model. An ElevenAgents conversation lasts 600 seconds by default, adjustable from 60 to 7,200 [el-agents-flow]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. API list price US$0.04 per 1,000 characters; a promotional price of US$0.011 per 1,000 characters (72% off) runs until 2026-10-12 [el-pricing-api]. In ElevenAgents the platform bills per call minute (US$0.08 per minute on the pricing page) and passes LLM cost through separately [el-pricing-agents]

benchmarks.name: Maker median inference latency (milliseconds)
benchmarks.setting: median inference latency, excluding application and network latency; maker figure on the models page

benchmarks.name: Maker median time to first speech (milliseconds)
benchmarks.setting: median time from request to audible speech in the maker's launch chart; measured September 2026 over WebSocket streaming with identical scripts and default settings, with network latency measured and removed for all systems; compared with Cartesia Sonic 3.6, xAI TTS, Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS and OpenAI GPT-4o mini TTS
